title: PortfolioOps
description: Designed and deployed a highly secure, automated personal portfolio website using AWS S3 cloud storage with custom CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions.
features: Static website hosting on AWS S3 with clean routing
Automated CI/CD deployment pipeline triggering on git push
Secure IAM configuration following the principle of least privilege
Fully responsive and optimized front-end layout

title: Local Service Marketplace
description: A MERN stack platform that connects users with nearby service providers for household tasks, highlighting modern full-stack engineering practices.
features: Dynamic service provider discovery and matching algorithm
Secure user and provider authentication and profile management
Real-time reviews and booking status tracking
Responsive design supporting all device types
